county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director attendance records were not available.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was observed positioned in the hallway to monitor two seperate classrooms during naptime.

top_violation_types.title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Observed that facility does not allow parents to have access inside the building to drop off children.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children are left in buggies longer than fiftteen minutes which is the maximum time frame a child may be in a restrictive device.
